summary: Step out of the Stranded Graveyard. White-Faced Varré greets you at The First Step — speak to him (starts his questline). Pick up the multiplayer tools at the Summoning Pool, then ride north to the ruined church. The Tree Sentinel patrols the road — dodge around him on the left;

Ride northwest to the large Godrick soldier camp at the base of Stormgate. Grab the map stele and the underground cellar. After you have Torrent from Melina, rest at any grace until night and return to Church of Elleh — Renna appears here once and only once.

Head north along the Stormgate road into Stormhill. Boc the Seamster is disguised as a tree just east of the road north of the lake — free him. Roderika sits in the shack brooding; exhaust her dialogue. At night a Deathbird patrols the lower hillside road for the Blue Feathered B

Continue north past Saintsbridge. D, Hunter of the Dead appears at the bridge — speak to him to start his quest. Warmaster's Shack has Knight Bernahl who sells Ashes of War. At night the Bell Bearing Hunter invades the shack. The Stormhill Evergaol is north of the shack.

Head south into the Murkwater ravine. Yura's invasion occurs near the ravine entrance (he protects you from a bloody finger invader). Murkwater Cave has Patches — don't kill him. Murkwater Catacombs are directly south. Deathtouched Catacombs are east along the ravine.

Cross east to Mistwood. Blaidd the Half-Wolf is howling from the ruins tower — first get the Finger Snap gesture from Kalé (Church of Elleh), then use it under Blaidd to summon him down. The Minor Erdtree in Mistwood has two Crystal Tears on its altar. Kenneth Haight is northeast

Head southeast to Fort Haight — Kenneth's fort overrun by Godrick soldiers and a Misbegotten knight. Clear it, grab the essential Dectus Medallion (Left), and return to Kenneth. The Forlorn Hound Evergaol is just west of here — summon Blaidd for the fight.

Head northeast along the eastern Limgrave coast to the Third Church of Marika. The Flask of Wondrous Physick and a Sacred Tear are here. The Summonwater Village east of the church has a Tibia Mariner boss and the Green Turtle Talisman behind a Stonesword Key lock.

Flying Dragon Agheel patrols Agheel Lake — fight it for a Dragon Heart, then head southwest to Coastal Cave to finish Boc's quest. The cave exits to the Church of Dragon Communion on the coastal cliffs where Dragon Communion Incantations are purchased. Stormfoot Catacombs are nor

Waypoint Ruins sit on the central road. The cellar below has a Mad Pumpkin Head boss guarding Sorceress Sellen. Clear the boss, meet Sellen, and give her the Royal House Scroll if you found it. The Greataxe is in a chest on the nearby caravan.

Two dungeons cluster north: Groveside Cave (Flamedrake Talisman) and Highroad Cave (Blue Dancer Charm + Shamshir). Then head to the Limgrave Tower Bridge — the path to the Divine Tower requires crossing it. The Fringefolk Hero's Grave back in the Stranded Graveyard is here for cl

The Limgrave Tunnels are in a ravine just west of Waypoint Ruins. A Stonedigger Troll boss at the bottom drops the Roar Medallion. Also check the Tree Sentinel near the Church of Elleh now that you have better gear — he drops the Golden Halberd.

Cross the Bridge of Sacrifice south from Limgrave. Irina sits by the road just south of the bridge — speak to her and receive her letter. Grab the Stonesword Key at the barricade, the Map Fragment from the stele, and sweep the Tombsward area churches for Sacred Tears.

Sweep the peninsula's interior — Fourth Church of Marika for another Sacred Tear, Oridys's Rise for a Memory Stone (solve the turtle puzzle), the Minor Erdtree (kill the Erdtree Avatar for two Crystal Tears), and Demi-Human Forest Ruins for the Demi-Human Queen's Staff and sorcer

Eastern peninsula — Isolated Merchant at his shack sells useful early items. Night's Cavalry patrols near Castle Morne Rampart at night. Tombsward Cave has cookbook and Viridian Amber Medallion. Earthbore Cave has the Spelldrake Talisman. Tombsward Catacombs have a Stonesword Key

Castle Morne is the dungeon climax of the Weeping Peninsula. Deliver Irina's letter to Edgar atop the ramparts FIRST — then fight your way to the boss. The Leonine Misbegotten drops the Grafted Blade Greatsword (Great Rune of Unalloyed Gold alternative). After the boss speak to E

Final peninsula sweep: Morne Tunnel for the Rusted Anchor, Impaler's Catacombs for Demi-Human Ashes and rare imp armor drops, the Deathbird at night for the Sacrificial Axe, and the Tower of Return for the Weeping Peninsula Teardrop Scarab incantations.

Margit guards the castle gate. Buy his Shackle from Patches (or bring Lone Wolf ashes) for a safer fight. Exhaust Rogier's summon dialogue at the site outside the fog gate — he moves to Roundtable Hold after you defeat Margit.
Enter via Gostoc's side gate (left of the main gate). Navigate the crumbling cliffsides through arrow traps and Warhawk eyries to the Gateside Chamber grace inside the castle walls.

Climb from the cliffside cellars to the rooftops. Two Stonesword Key pickups here — one on the rooftops after the Grafted Scion encounter, one in the Underground Crypt. The Iron Whetblade in the armory is critical for infusion options.

Descend into the castle courtyards, cellars and the Underground Crypt. The Ulcerated Tree Spirit in the crypt drops a Golden Seed and is the source of Rogier's infection. Nepheli Loux is found just before the lift to the upper castle.

The final push to Godrick. Collect the Chrysalids' Memento from the grafting grounds — give it to Roderika at Stormhill Shack to move her to Roundtable Hold. Restore Godrick's Great Rune at the Divine Tower of Limgrave afterward.
Collect the Stormveil-tied quest rewards at Roundtable Hold, then restore Godrick's Great Rune. Rogier's Rapier is given here; later collecting his Bell Bearing closes his questline.

Enter Liurnia via the cliffside path south of the academy. The Church of Irith is the first major landmark — pick up the Sacred Tear and meet Thops. Collect the Academy Scroll from the ruins east of the church. Hyetta begins her questline here if Irina is dead.

Sweep the south lake shore heading north. Collect the west map fragment, visit Purified Ruins for Hyetta's second grape, then swing east to pick up the east map fragment and Dragon Cult Prayerbook on the eastern shore before approaching the Academy gate.

to: Raya Lucaria Academy (Church of the Cuckoo)
summary: Obtain the Academy Glintstone Key from Glintstone Dragon Smarag's island west of the Academy, then enter Raya Lucaria. The Church of the Cuckoo grace is just inside and holds the second Academy Glintstone Key (for Thops) on a chandelier.

from: Raya Lucaria Academy (Church of the Cuckoo)
summary: Navigate the graveyard, waterwheel, and rooftops to the Schoolhouse Classroom grace. Collect the Conspectus Scroll, Graven-School Talisman (illusory wall), second Academy Glintstone Key (chandelier — for Thops), and an Imbued Sword Key on the rooftops.

Fight through the Debate Parlor and up to Rennala. The Red Wolf of Radagon guards the Debate Parlor. Rennala is the main boss — her Great Rune of the Unborn enables larval-tear rebirth. Give Thops the second Academy Glintstone Key before leaving.

Head south to the Rose Church on the western lakeshore. This is where Varré relocates after Stormveil. His questline gives the Pureblood Knight's Medal — early access to Mohgwyn Palace, skipping the Haligtree medallion route. Complete his bloody finger invasion tasks here.

Sweep the southwestern lakeshore: Boilprawn Shack (Blackguard Big Boggart for Rya's necklace), Four Belfries (Imbued Sword Keys + Stormhawk King), then the Village of the Albinaurics (Haligtree Medallion right half, Latenna, Nepheli quest). Get Rya's Necklace here to start her qu

Head north through the lake to Caria Manor in northwest Liurnia. Clear the manor gardens and upper level to fight Royal Knight Loretta. Defeat her to unlock the Three Sisters and access to Ranni's Rise.

Ranni's questline begins in Three Sisters. Become her vassal, meet Blaidd, Seluvis, and Iji. Collect Seluvis's Introduction for Sellen's questline. The memory stone in Seluvis's Rise and the quest steps here are the highest-priority items in this area.

Complete the eastern shore sweep before heading north. Jarburg (meet Jar-Bairn), the eastern highway (map fragment, Tibia Mariner, Dragon Cult Prayerbook), Church of Vows (Miriel, sacred tear, Bell Bearing Hunter), and the Minor Erdtree for crystal tears.

Head north on the Bellum Highway toward the Grand Lift of Dectus. The Black Knife Catacombs are to the northeast — collect the Black Knifeprint for Rogier's questline. Hyetta's third grape step is at the Gate Town Bridge. The Radagon's Rises puzzle towers give memory stones.

Final Liurnia sweep before ascending to Altus. Collect the north Liurnia map, Smithing-Stone Bell Bearing from the crystal tunnel, and the Imbued Sword Key from Seluvis's Rise area. Hyetta's fourth step is at Bellum Church. Ensure all quest items are handed in.

Descend the Mistwood elevator into the underground. Grab the map stele and the nearby chest, then follow the river north to Siofra River Bank grace. Blaidd appears here as part of Ranni's quest — speak to him.

Light all eight pillars/skull fires scattered through the underground to summon the Ancestor Spirit at Hallowhorn Grounds. The fires are spread across the eastern half of Siofra; each is guarded by ancestral followers. After the boss, loot the surrounding area.

Continue north through Worshippers' Woods to collect remaining loot. The Dragonkin Soldier boss (northwest waygate) requires the Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace — this is accessible only from Nokron, so the Dragonkin fight is deferred until after Radahn. Note: Great Jar's Arsenal ta

Enter Caelid from the northwest at the Smoldering Church, then ride south along the highway toward Sellia and Gowry's Shack. Pick up the map and road items along the way. Note: Caelid is accessible early via a trap chest in Limgrave's Dragon-Burnt Ruins that teleports you to Sell

Light Sellia's three beacon towers to lift the seal on its locked buildings, then sweep the entire town. Sellen's questline sends you to find Primeval Sorcerer Lusat in Sellia Hideaway — do so now. Return the Unalloyed Gold Needle to Gowry after defeating Commander O'Neil.

Fight Commander O'Neil in the swamp's heart. Return the broken needle to Gowry, reload, collect the repaired needle, then deliver it to Millicent at the Church of the Plague northeast of Sellia. Also sweep the Gael Tunnel dungeon (south of Caelid highway) for the Moonveil katana.

Sweep the remaining western Caelid items before riding to Redmane Castle. Fort Gael holds the Flame of the Redmanes ash of war and the Katar weapon. The Caelid Wilds has several corpse pickups along the main road.

The Radahn Festival is triggered by progressing Ranni's questline (meeting her at Ranni's Rise) OR by activating any grace in Altus Plateau. When the festival is active, enemies vanish from the castle and NPCs gather in the plaza. Alexander and Blaidd are present as optional summ

After Radahn, collect remaining Caelid items: Radahn soldier armor drops, armor sets from defeated enemies, remaining cookbooks and key items. The key-item-dectus-medallion-right is in Fort Faroth (Dragonbarrow) — that's handled in the Dragonbarrow region.

from: Third Church of Marika (Limgrave sending gate)
summary: A sending gate northeast of the Third Church of Marika in Limgrave teleports you directly to the Bestial Sanctum in northeast Dragonbarrow — accessible very early before Caelid is cleared. Gurranq, Beast Clergyman, trades incantations for Deathroot. The Black Blade Kindred field

Ride south through Dragonbarrow to Elder Dragon Greyoll sleeping on the plateau east of Fort Faroth. Greyoll herself can be bled out without a true fight (stab her tail repeatedly while her whelps aggro). Fort Faroth holds the Dectus Medallion (Right) needed for the Grand Lift of

Climb the outside of the Divine Tower of Caelid to activate Radahn's Great Rune. A Godskin Apostle guards the top. The Godslayer's Greatsword is inside the tower. Afterward, the Great Rune is fully powered — equip it and use a Rune Arc to receive the rune's effect.

After defeating Starscourge Radahn, a meteor falls on Limgrave near Fort Haight in Mistwood, creating a crater. Descend through the crater to reach Nokron, Eternal City. The crater is on the east side of the Mistwood, southeast of the Mistwood Ruins grace.

Navigate the rooftops and elevated streets of Nokron to reach the Mimic Tear boss. Silver Tears — liquid silver enemies that mimic the player's equipment — fill these streets. The Mimic Tear is a mirror of your own character and loadout.

Continue south from the Mimic Tear grace into the Ancestral Woods and then across the rooftops to Night's Sacred Ground. The Fingerslayer Blade is the primary objective — it is in a chest below a chair-crypt in Night's Sacred Ground and is required for Ranni's questline. The Mimi

The Aqueduct-Facing Cliffs grace connects Nokron to the Siofra River Aqueduct — the path forward to Deeproot Depths. The Valiant Gargoyle duo boss guards the coffin at the aqueduct's end. After defeating them, enter the coffin to be transported to Deeproot Depths (separate region

region: Ainsel River, Nokstella & Lake of Rot
summary: After delivering the Fingerslayer Blade to Ranni, climb to the top of Renna's Rise (the northern tower at Three Sisters in Liurnia) and pass through its sending gate to arrive in upper Ainsel River. Pick up the Miniature Ranni from the tomb near the arrival point — this is requir

region: Ainsel River, Nokstella & Lake of Rot
summary: Continue north through Ainsel River Main into Nokstella, Eternal City — a second underground city populated by Silver Tears and Nox enemies. The Moon of Nokstella talisman (adds 2 memory slots) and Ghost-Glovewort Picker's Bell Bearing [2] are the key finds. The Baleful Shadow (R

region: Ainsel River, Nokstella & Lake of Rot
summary: Descend via elevator from Nokstella Waterfall Basin to reach the Lake of Rot. This is a poisonous lake of Scarlet Rot — equip Preserving Boluses, the Immunizing Cured Meat, or flask Crystal Tears. Activate the four pillars to raise stone platforms across the lake.

region: Ainsel River, Nokstella & Lake of Rot
summary: Proceed south through the Grand Cloister to the coffin at the waterfall's tip — this transports you to Astel's fog gate. Astel is a mandatory Ranni quest boss. After defeating Astel, use the Dark Moon Ring on the lift north of the arena to ascend to Moonlight Altar on the surface

Climb the ladder at the Ravine-Veiled Village into the Ruin-Strewn Precipice dungeon. Fight through the magma-infested cliffs to Magma Wyrm Makar and take the lift at the top to emerge on Altus Plateau. This is the foot-approach alternative to the Grand Lift of Dectus (the lift r

Sweep the central plateau along the main road, collecting key items near the highway junction and meeting Corhyn who has followed you here. The Forest-Spanning Greatbridge grace is reached by continuing north; Goldmask stands on the broken bridge south of it.

Sweep the eastern half of the plateau past the Erdtree-Gazing Hill toward the Bower of Bounty. The Outer Wall Phantom Tree grace marks the Capital Outskirts entrance; hold off on entering Leyndell for now. Pick up items in the windmill area south of Bower of Bounty.

The Windmill Villages are a celebration of the Godskin Apostle cult. Killing the Godskin Apostle at Dominula triggers a Millicent quest step. Pick up the unique Celebrant's weapons scattered throughout the village buildings and fields.

The Shaded Castle sits in a poison mire in the northwest corner of the plateau. It holds Valkyrie's Prosthesis (critical for Millicent's questline) and Marais Executioner's Sword from boss Elemer. Patches is also wounded here post-Volcano Manor and gives you Dancer's Castanets fo

Sweep the Capital Outskirts: the Outer Wall Battleground area (Dung Eater meets Boggart here), Hermit Merchant's Shack, the three dungeon graces (Auriza Side Tomb, Auriza Hero's Grave, Sealed Tunnel), and the Divine Tower of West Altus. Wrap up with the Capital Rampart grace befo

Final Altus sweep: the Old Altus Tunnel and Altus Tunnel for somberstone/smithing stones and their bell bearings, plus the scattered field items including the Perfumer's Grotto, Sage's Cave, and remaining plateau collectibles.

Ascend the treacherous switchback ladders of Mt. Gelmir from the Bridge of Iniquity. Patches kicks you off a ledge as a warning here — speak to him before continuing. The Primeval Sorcerer Azur and Hermit Village are reached by descending the southeast face.

The Hermit Village on the southeast Gelmir face is inhabited by exiled sorcerers and demi-humans. Demi-Human Queen Maggie guards the path to Primeval Sorcerer Azur, who gives Comet Azur freely. Loop back via the Seethewater River area for dungeon items.

Two challenging dungeons with strong loot. The Gelmir Hero's Grave chariot dungeon hides a Bloodhound Knight and Gelmir Knight set. Wyndham Catacombs (north plateau) contains the Pearldrake Talisman +1.

CRITICAL QUEST HUB — Volcano Manor holds three assassination contracts that MUST all be completed before fighting Rykard. Killing Rykard first permanently ends Tanith's questline, forfeiting: Taker's Cameo (Contract 3), Serpentbone Blade (Contract 2), Magma Whip Candlestick (Patc

After completing ALL THREE contracts, Tanith transports you to Rykard's chamber. Pick up the Serpent Hunter from just inside the fog gate before engaging. After Rykard's death, Tanith moves to consume his corpse — speak to her there for a final exchange, then return for Bernahl's

Enter the Capital Outskirts and fight through the outer wall approach. The map fragment stele is on the road near the rampart gate. Pick up Seedbed Curses scattered here for the Dung Eater questline. Boggart has moved to the moat near the Outer Wall Battleground — see him before

Enter the Royal Capital from the east and sweep the outer rampart areas, the battlements, and the Avenue area leading toward the Erdtree. Key items are scattered throughout the streets and rooftops. The Lower Capital Church grace is accessible below.

Climb the giant Erdtree root south of West Capital Rampart to reach the Erdtree Sanctuary grace. This requires defeating Godfrey's golden shade — a mandatory boss guarding the inner sanctum. Explore the Fortified Manor for the Volcano Manor co-op invasion (Bernahl) and gather ite

From the Erdtree Sanctuary, navigate through the Queen's Bedchamber and the colosseum district toward the Elden Throne. Defeat Morgott the Omen King — the final mandatory boss before the Mountaintops. He drops the Rold Medallion needed for the Grand Lift of Rold.

The Subterranean Shunning-Grounds is a sewer dungeon beneath Leyndell, accessed from a well in the city. Drop through the grate near the Underground Roadside grace to navigate the rat-and-Miranda-flower-infested sewers. Dung Eater's cell is here. Mohg the Omen guards the deepest

CRITICAL DECISION POINT — The Three Fingers are at the very bottom of the Subterranean Shunning-Grounds, behind an illusory altar at the back of the Cathedral of the Forsaken. Approaching the Three Fingers LOCKS all endings except Lord of Frenzied Flame. The ONLY reversal is Miqu

Deeproot Depths is accessed via the Valiant Gargoyle duo boss coffin in the Siofra Aqueduct (Nokron, Eternal City). Ride the coffin to arrive at the Root-Facing Cliffs. Navigate the enormous tree root landscape southeast toward the Nameless Eternal City, collecting the map fragme

Traverse the giant roots to reach the Across the Roots grace, then proceed to the Crucible Knight Siluria boss (optional but drops Siluria's Tree). Continue to the Prince of Death's Throne grace and speak with Fia to advance her questline. Fia's Champions invade to protect her —

Ascend via the Rold Medallion gifted by Melina after defeating Morgott. Collect the west map fragment immediately on exit, then ride north to the Zamor Ruins. Pick up the sorcery and smithing bell bearing in the ruins before pushing toward the Whiteridge Road grace.

Ride northwest from Zamor toward Whiteridge Road, collecting the Prelate's Charge ash of war from the Fire Monk camp. Pick up the Somberstone bell bearing outside the First Church of Marika to the east. Latenna will mention the medallion location if you have spoken to her at Slum

Head northeast to Castle Sol for Commander Niall and the left half of the Haligtree Secret Medallion. This is the key item that unlocks the Consecrated Snowfield. Pick up the East map fragment on the way back via the Freezing Lake chain path.

Southwest sweep: Spiritcaller Cave on the western bank of Freezing Lake (2 Stonesword Keys required), then south to the Giants' Mountaintop Catacombs and Giant-Conquering Hero's Grave. The Hero's Grave houses the Zamor armor set and the Fire Prelate's Giant's Seal.

Southeast from Giants' Gravepost to the two Flame Peak catacombs, then to Church of Repose before ascending the chain bridges to Fire Giant. Collect the crimsonwhorl tear on the cliff ledge south of the Gravepost. The Corhyn/Goldmask quest bridge is just north of the Gravepost.

Cross the chain bridges to confront the Fire Giant — mandatory boss to reach the Forge of the Giants. After defeating him, speak to Melina at the Forge of the Giants grace. CRITICAL WARNING: Accepting Melina's offer to burn the Erdtree here triggers the Leyndell lock — any Leynde

Access requires BOTH halves of the Haligtree Secret Medallion — right half from Village of the Albinaurics (Liurnia), left half from Castle Sol. At the Grand Lift of Rold, select 'Hoist secret medallion' to reach the hidden path. Collect the map fragment on the road through the b

West sweep before Ordina: the Night's Cavalry caravan at night drops the full armor set, the enemy caravan contains the Flowing Curved Sword and St. Trina's Torch. The Sanguine Noble invader near Yelough Anix Ruins activates the Mohgwyn teleporter and drops the Sanguine Noble arm

Ordina's evergaol puzzle unlocks the portal to Miquella's Haligtree. Then ride northeast to the Apostate Derelict to conclude Latenna's questline and collect dungeon rewards from Cave of the Forlorn and Yelough Anix Tunnel.
Return to Ordina and pass through the now-activated portal to Miquella's Haligtree.

Access Mohgwyn Palace via Varré's Pureblood Knight's Medal (complete his questline including 3 invasions and blood-soaking the Lord of Blood's Favor) OR via the Snowfield teleporter northwest of Yelough Anix Ruins (requires defeating the Sanguine Noble invader there). Collect the

Ascend through the Dynasty Mausoleum to Mohg, Lord of Blood. The Nihil ritual in phase 2 drains all flasks — use Mohg's Shackle to interrupt it once, or acquire the Purifying Crystal Tear (from Eleonora's Poleblade drop in Altus Plateau) to negate its damage entirely.

Use the teleporter in Ordina after lighting all four spectral candles to travel to the Haligtree canopy. Collect the two Stonesword Keys and the Oracle Envoy Ashes near the landing point, and grab the Prattling Pate and Envoy Crown before descending.

Navigate the Haligtree Town canopy section — descend through branches and rooftops collecting the Pearldrake Talisman +2, Viridian Amber Medallion +2, and Boltdrake Talisman +2 before reaching Loretta's boss arena at the Haligtree Promenade. Defeat Loretta for her two drops.

Enter Elphael via the elevator after defeating Loretta. Collect the Rotten Crystal Sword immediately past the Elphael Inner Wall grace, then fight through the rot-infected streets. Grab the Miquellan Knight's Sword near the Prayer Room, the Rotten Staff from the Erdtree Avatar, a

The Drainage Channel grace is the site of Millicent's questline conclusion. A gold summon sign (assist path) or red summon sign (betray path) appears on the ground here. Choose your path — both are mutually exclusive and give different talismans. Also collect the Dragoncrest Grea

Descend to the Haligtree Roots grace and collect the Traveler's set in the adjacent side room. Defeat Malenia, Blade of Miquella — one of the most difficult bosses in the game. Collect her remembrance and great rune. If on the assist path, use the Unalloyed Gold Needle on the Sca

Entering the Shadow Realm requires defeating both Starscourge Radahn (Caelid) and Mohg, Lord of Blood (Mohgwyn Palace). After Mohg falls, interact with the withered arm inside the cocoon to be transported to the Land of Shadow.

Grab the map stele and the first collectibles from the open plain, then meet Miquella's followers at Three-Path Cross. Leda, Hornsent, and Redmane Freyja all introduce themselves at the crossroads grace — exhaust every character's dialogue before moving on.

Ride northwest to the Church of Consolation for the first pair of Scadutree Fragments. Detour south to the Abandoned Ailing Village for a Revered Spirit Ash, then sweep the Scorched Ruins. Collect Forager Brood Cookbooks from the friendly pest creatures — never kill them or Moore

Belurat Tower Settlement is the first Legacy Dungeon. Meet Moore and Sir Ansbach at the Main Gate. Exhaust Ansbach's cross dialogue now — it locks after the Great Rune breaks. Find the Storeroom Key and Well Depths Key inside, speak to Hornsent Grandam, then defeat the Divine Bea

Exit Belurat and ride southeast toward Castle Ensis. Meet Thiollier at Pillar Path Cross to advance Moore's quest, and collect the Scadutree Fragment at the Pillar Path Miquella's Cross. Give Thiollier the Black Syrup from Moore before the Great Rune breaks.

Castle Ensis is the second legacy dungeon. Collect keys, the Loyal Knight's Cookbook, and Milady inside. Defeat Rellana, Twin Moon Knight — Leda's summon sign appears at her fog gate. After the boss, meet Hornsent at the exit as he passes through toward Scadu Altus.

Sweep the remaining Gravesite Plain zones before ascending to Scadu Altus. Prospect Town (west) holds the Outer God Heirloom talisman. Collect the remaining Scadutree Fragments at Miquella's Crosses and pick up Gravesite Plain weapons, armor, spirit ashes, and cookbooks.

Cross into Scadu Altus from Castle Ensis. Grab the map fragment at the first stele. Leda and Hornsent meet you at Highroad Cross with new cross-map dialogue — exhaust both before advancing. Collect the Monk's Missive (launches Dryleaf Dane's quest) and complete the Dane duel at M

to: Ruined Forge of Starfall Past & Recluses' River
summary: Sweep the Fort of Reprimand for its dungeon loot — Black Knight Edreed drops the Crucible Wings ash of war. Continue south to Recluses' River Upstream and Downstream for the Moldmonger bell bearing and downstream items. Then head to the Ruined Forge of Starfall Past for the Ancie

Enter Shadow Keep — the central legacy dungeon of Scadu Altus. The Golden Hippopotamus guards the Main Gate Plaza. Hornsent and Freyja can both be summoned. After the boss, Ansbach is in the Storehouse First Floor reading scripture — exhaust his dialogue now and get the quest cha

The Church District is the flooding sub-dungeon of Shadow Keep. Pull the drainage lever (via the northern ladder past the Giant Bats) to flood the area and access the Sunken Chapel and deeper zones. Use the Iris of Grace or Iris of Occultation on Fire Knight Queelign in the Praye

From the Shadow Keep Back Gate, perform the O Mother gesture at the statue to access the Scaduview Hinterlands. Sweep the Hinterlands for the Scadutree fragments at Miquella's Crosses, Sharpshot Talisman, Golden Braid, and Minor Erdtree Spell in Shaman Village. Defeat Commander G

Count Ymir's questline is headquartered at the Cathedral of Manus Metyr. Begin here: speak with Ymir for the Ruins Map and Hole-Laden Necklace, then ring the bells at Finger Ruins of Rhia (Southern Shore, region 20) and Finger Ruins of Dheo (Scaduview). Return after each bell for

Darklight Catacombs are accessible from the Recluses' River area and lead to Abyssal Woods. The Death Knight set, Bigmouth Imp Ashes, Viridian Amber Medallion +3, and Barbed Staff-Spear are inside. Then sweep the Eastern and Northern Nameless Mausoleums (Rakshasa, Dancer of Ranah

Enter the Cerulean Coast from the Ellac Riverbed to the south. The coast is lined with brilliant blue flowers and colossal stone coffins. Demi-humans, giant crabs, and jellyfish populate the shoreline. Thiollier must already be spoken to at Pillar Path Cross (Scadu Altus region)

to: Stone Coffin Fissure (Garden of Deep Purple)
summary: Descend south from Cerulean Coast Cross into the Stone Coffin Fissure ravine. Defeat the Putrescent Knight — a legend boss formed from putrescence that imbibed St. Trina's nectar — to reach the Garden of Deep Purple. Thiollier is here after you have met St. Trina. Begin the four-

From the Garden of Deep Purple, navigate the Fissure Depths and ascend back to the Cerulean Coast surface. Proceed east along the southern shoreline to the Finger Ruins of Rhia — a ring of massive finger-shaped obelisks pointing inward toward a hanging bell. Ring the bell to adva

From Finger Ruins of Rhia, head north along the coast toward the Grand Altar of Dragon Communion at Foot of the Jagged Peak, then turn west-southwest to enter Charo's Hidden Grave — a field of crimson lilies between the Cerulean Coast and southern Gravesite Plain. Ghostflame flow

region: DLC: Rauh, Abyssal Woods & Jagged Peak
summary: Enter the Ancient Ruins of Rauh via the Moorth Ruins tunnel from Scadu Altus, descending into the wetland canyon of the Scorpion River (Rauh Base). The ruins are flooded, overgrown, and split by a chasm. Rauh Base connects to Shadow Keep via a great bridge to the east. Work the T

region: DLC: Rauh, Abyssal Woods & Jagged Peak
summary: Ascend through the Ancient Ruins of Rauh proper — the flooded upper ruins with scarlet rot swamp areas, Furnace Golems, and Divine Bird Warriors. Key items are scattered across the flooded platforms and hidden alcoves. Romina, Saint of the Bud is a MANDATORY boss — must be defeat

region: DLC: Rauh, Abyssal Woods & Jagged Peak
summary: Enter the Abyssal Woods via Darklight Catacombs at the terminus of Recluses' River in Scadu Altus. Jori, Elder Inquisitor guards the catacombs entrance. The woods are a thick forbidden forest at the ravine's depths, untouched by sunlight. CRITICAL: Torrent cannot be summoned here

region: DLC: Rauh, Abyssal Woods & Jagged Peak
summary: Dragon's Pit is a cave dungeon reached from Gravesite Plain near Pillar Path Waypoint — bear south-southwest. Its dragon-themed architecture was a rite of passage for Dragon Communion practitioners. Defeat the Ancient Dragon-Man to reach Jagged Peak beyond. Ascend Jagged Peak's s

region: DLC: Rauh, Abyssal Woods & Jagged Peak
summary: The Grand Altar of Dragon Communion is in the Jagged Peak foothills. The Dragon Communion Priestess here explains the ritual history. After defeating Bayle the Dread, return to the Altar — she drops the Priestess Heart (MISSABLE: confessing you put her to sleep locks this acquisi
